title: An eval scaffold overwrote the live ~/relay/bin/relay
what: setup-relay-stub.sh refuses unless HOME is a run's own throwaway home (a marker the eval harness sets, or HOME under the system temp folder) and never writes into a git checkout; the scaffolds call it only that way. relay doctor names a main checkout whose bin/relay differs from HEAD.
why: 28 Oct 11:49 UTC: the main checkout's bin/relay was replaced by evals/plugin/relay-stub.py (byte-identical), so every `relay` command on this machine printed two stub usage lines (`relay queue` and `relay queue count` broke for the front). evals/plugin/setup-relay-stub.sh line 7 copies the stub to "$HOME/relay/bin/relay", meant for the eval run's own $HOME; a scaffold.sh run (recall-decision, keep-owner-words, keep-owner-words-en) with the real HOME writes over the owner's relay. guard-main then refuses `git restore bin/relay` in the main checkout, so the front cannot undo it.
failing_case: HOME=$HOME evals/plugin/recall-decision/scaffold.sh in a workspace: ~/relay/bin/relay becomes relay-stub.py.
pass_cases: The same refuses and writes nothing.
Inside `claude plugin eval --scaffold` (its own HOME) the stub is placed as today and recall-decision passes.

fact: 28 Oct: the four-eval-cases lane's critic found the trigger: tests/test_eval_system_rules.py runs the three new scaffolds with the real $HOME, so one run of that test file overwrites ~/relay/bin/relay. A fix (scaffolds run with a temporary HOME) is commit 1a5f1d49 on wt/four-eval-cases-carry-hand-copies-of-the, not landed; that lane stopped at a red gate caused only by the broken live bin/relay (its eval tests: 88 passed).
